description: The image displays three pie charts labeled "easy," "medium," and "hard," each representing the distribution of performance across four categories—N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, and N+K−—as indicated by the legend on the right. The "easy" chart shows the largest segment is N−K+ at 45.9%, followed by N+K+ at 40.6%, N+K− at 10.1%, and N−K− at 3.3%. In the "medium" chart, N+K+ accounts for 44.6%, N−K+ for 44.3%, N−K− for 7.2%, and N+K− for 3.9%. The "hard" chart has N−K− as the largest segment at 36.8%, followed by N−K+ at 36.2%, N+K+ at 20.1%, and N+K− at 7.0%. Each slice is labeled with its corresponding percentage, and the colors used are teal for N+K+, light brown for N−K+, dark brown for N−K−, and reddish-brown for N+K−. The charts are arranged horizontally, with the "CoT" label positioned below the "medium" chart.
